name: Speaker Source
description: Connect speaker playback and actions to dashboard panels, using sample data or a compatible web service.

displayName.title: Name in admin
displayName.description: Name this copy for its purpose, such as Lobby weather or Workshop energy. Its connection ID stays the same.

provider.title: Data source
provider.description: Choose where this copy gets its data. Sample data lets you try the display before connecting a service.

baseUrl.title: Service URL
baseUrl.description: Base address of the compatible service, reachable from the Castboard server.

headers.title: Request headers
headers.description: Optional request headers as a JSON object. Saved values are hidden and never sent to displays.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout · milliseconds
timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait for an upstream response before showing an unavailable state.

displayNotes: A compatible media service can implement `POST /api/sonos/like` with `{ "trackUri": "spotify:track:…" }` to save the displayed song to Spotify Liked Songs.
